answer: Treat grove as one clone, jetty as the single anchor binding key, route and first judged output, so duplicates collide. A ballot needs signatures from three clusters whose jetty roots share no fork for three epochs, and the kth grove must burn k×k onyx in one serial epoch, tagged to that key. n grove need unrelated clusters, n serial epochs and cubic onyx. It breaks if jetty merges aliases, clusters share operators, or onyx moves.
